FRENCH — MOCK EXAM #6
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: FRENCH
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Interactive Speaking, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Interactive Speaking.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Interactive Speaking.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Interactive Speaking.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Interactive Speaking.

2. “Bonjour” is used to say: (1 mark)
   A. Good morning / hello
   B. Thank you
   C. Excuse me
   D. Good night only

3. When practising Active listening 1.4 Listening for information, which approach is best? (1 mark)

   A. porte
